name_zh: 同时间自映射偏差消除
formal_object: Frozen direct-coordinate decoder F_t(x)=F(z,x,a,t) in R^3; anchor x in R^3. F_a need not equal x.

operations.condition: The nuisance field b is shared over target times
operations.output: Differences F_t-F_a are invariant to b

operations.condition: Finite second moments; shared vertex identity

derivation_steps.justification: Substitute t=a; no assumption of decoder self-consistency.

derivation_steps.statement: Replacing every F_t by F_t+b leaves H_t unchanged.
derivation_steps.justification: The same additive nuisance cancels, pointwise.
Expand the squared norm; do not discard the cross term.

assumptions: The decoder is evaluated on the same anchor query and context.
The common-bias explanation is conditional, not diagnosed by the 16 published scores.
A boundary identity is not a bound on CD-M; corrected points may leave [-1,1].
Do not silently clip the correction: clipping changes its algebra and requires a separate constraint/record.
method_expression: Query F_a once and F_t for each original t; output H_t=x+F_t-F_a. Preserve faces and all time IDs.
distinguishing_prediction: The correction should help when self-map error positively predicts downstream error strongly enough to exceed half its own squared magnitude; zero self-map residual gives no change.
falsifier: Reject the common-bias explanation if actual self-map residuals do not predict the downstream error and the method loses to equal-call uncorrected/bias-fit controls on fresh native cases.
closest_alternative: Uncorrected ActionMesh; simple mean-bias correction; SFG already anchors latent sampling trajectories by initial shape plus differences (Eq.2). Historical m02 checks decoder cycles, not this shared-bias risk criterion. The decoded-coordinate variant is a diagnostic/baseline until a material functional delta is established.
decisive_comparison: Same latent/context/seed, full native ActionBench scoring; F_t versus H_t versus mean-bias fit; all arms pay the self-query cost or receive equal total budget.
operational_delta: Exact boundary and nuisance-invariance consequence; novelty beyond existing boundary correction remains pending.
feasibility_and_cost: One additional decoder target-time query per cached context; no training. Cache/replay and full-mesh timing must be qualified.
structural_signature: Pointwise deterministic self-map quotient, no covariance estimate, transport or temporal regularizer.
algebra_review_basis: Checked by substitution, additive-offset invariance and the full error expansion. No universal error-reduction assertion.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
